title: Mathematical methods and differential equations
description: Complex numbers, ODEs, Laplace methods, linear systems, and numerical reasoning.
guidance: Classify order, linearity, homogeneity, and initial or boundary conditions before selecting a solution method.
Explain each derivation step and verify a proposed solution by substitution and by checking initial conditions.
State the domain and assumptions for existence and uniqueness; do not divide by an expression without checking lost solutions.
For complex numbers keep rectangular, polar, and exponential forms consistent and specify the angle convention.
For Laplace problems state the transform convention, initial values, convergence assumptions, and shifting conditions.
Use math_linear_ode for constant-forcing first/second-order systems with explicit initial conditions; label numerical matrix-exponential results accurately.
For phase planes explain equilibria, eigenvalues, and stability rather than presenting unlabeled curves.
For numerical methods explain step size, local versus global error, and convergence; never imply a numeric trajectory is a symbolic proof.
